The card goes in two PRs:

- **PR 1, dispatched now, `Part of #28645`:** the by-name readers read their one item through `getItem(type, name)`, which the adapter already answers from the bundle and falls back to the by-name route for an item it lacks; views compose per object from the bundle with a list fallback for an unbundled object; `view` leaves `EAGER_TYPES`. No product-visible change besides fewer calls.
- **PR 2, held:** retiring `NavigationSyncEffect`'s whole-list diff changes when app navigation is written, so it waits on the maintainer: decision card #28680 (sub-issue of this card). This card closes when #28680 is ruled and its PR (if any) lands.
